sloka: यथा ने भरतो मान्यस्तथा भूयोऽपि राघावः ।कौसल्यातोऽरिक्तं च सो हि शुश्रूषते हि माम् ॥२-८-१८॥
transliteration: yathā ne bharato mānyastathā bhūyo'pi rāghāvaḥ ।kausalyāto'riktaṁ ca so hi śuśrūṣate hi mām ॥2-8-18॥

translations.english: For me, if Bharata is worthy of consideration Rama is worthier. He serves me even more (scrupulously) than he does Kausalya.
